experiment: PyLate 1.4.0 ARM64 training and reranking dependency probe

checks.pip_check: only pylate 1.4.0 requires fast-plaid, which is not installed

scope: Fresh isolated Python environment. The smoke script used a randomly initialized tiny BERT and synthetic data. No original model, dataset, or PLAID index was loaded.
limitations: The tested environment intentionally omitted fast-plaid because no supported Linux ARM64 distribution was available for the required version range.
This run did not build or query a PLAID index.
Synthetic metrics do not establish retrieval quality and do not reproduce the original SciFact experiment.
